title: Tweak Your Life
description: Death chests, anvil uses, sleep indicator, simple crop-harvest, remote enderchests & more. Add usefull tweaks to your SMP and take it on another level.
body:
# Tweak Your Life

Take your server to another level with these high quality vanilla tweaks. Whether you just want to have an **enderchest available everywhere** or boost your server with **death chests** and **advanced crop-harvesting**; you can choose what fits your needs by enabling and disabling features in the **config**.

## Available tweaks

- **simple crop-harvest**
  > Farm crops by just rightclicking them
- **glowberry glow**
  > Glow when eating glow berries (time also configurable)
- **death chests**
  > Never loose your stuff again! When dying, a death chest will spawn with your inventory contents inside
- **death coords**
  > After dying, there will be a message containing information to you death location (only visible for the player)
- **dimension prefix**
  > A prefix in the tablist to indicate in which dimension a player currently is
- **anvil uses**
  > Take a look at the anvil uses your items have by hovering over in the anvil inventory
- **remote enderchest**
  > Access your enderchest everywhere by using **/enderchest** or **/ec**
- **effect particles**
  > Disable particles when a player is using an invisibility potion
- **chat time**
  > Add the current time to your chat messages
- **sleep indicator**
  > Look who is sleeping and who's lying. Shows up in tablist
- **shulker swap**
  > Insert your shulker contents instantly in your base chests (shift-left click)
- **death count**
  > A death counter appears in the tablist

**_There are also some design tweaks to change the style of join/quit messages or player names._**
